actions.description: Use runtime WEEX frontend credentials, loginTool token generation, and WEEX token cookie injection to open a STG frontend login-state page.

defaultParameters.credentialSource: skills/weex-frontend-ops/.env.local or same-skill WEEX_FRONTEND_* runtime environment variables
defaultParameters.screenshot: only when --screenshot or WEEX_FRONTEND_SAVE_SCREENSHOT=true is set

successAssertions: account overview, account security text, or /account URL is visible

actions.description: Create a STG WEEX frontend email account through the validated test API path, inject the returned token cookie, and verify the account overview page.

defaultParameters.credentialSource: WEEX_FRONTEND_COMMON_PASSWORD from skills/weex-frontend-ops/.env.local or same-skill WEEX_FRONTEND_* runtime environment variables
defaultParameters.screenshot: only when --screenshot or WEEX_FRONTEND_SAVE_SCREENSHOT=true is set

successAssertions: account overview, account security text, or /account URL is visible

actions.description: Create multiple STG WEEX frontend email accounts through the validated test API path, with optional invite code, account-count concurrency capped at 100, and automatic backfill for failed submissions.

defaultParameters.credentialSource: WEEX_FRONTEND_COMMON_PASSWORD from skills/weex-frontend-ops/.env.local or same-skill WEEX_FRONTEND_* runtime environment variables

successAssertions: each successful account has a UID
failed submissions are backfilled with new emails until requested count is reached or max attempts is exceeded

actions.description: Use runtime WEEX frontend credentials and loginTool access token to call the STG authenticated asset transfer API from spot to contract.
keywords: 资金从现货划转到合约

defaultParameters.credentialSource: skills/weex-frontend-ops/.env.local or same-skill WEEX_FRONTEND_* runtime environment variables

successAssertions: loginTool login returns an accessToken without printing it
